why: goh's self-walk (tests/test_self_walk.py, GOH.CLASS.SELF, 2026-11-15): every scanner in the registry run over goh itself with no seed, no grace and every opt-in on. `findings` is goh's own debt per scanner, counted as the distinct path:line sites it names; it only shrinks, and done is an empty `findings`. `enable`, `not_run` and `unjudged` are not debt: how the walk turns an opt-in scanner on, a scanner with nothing in goh to judge, and one that ran and said it cannot judge here.

not_run.a file that calls X calls Y: GOH_REQUIRES_CALL is a repo's own rule list; goh declares no rule, so the step has nothing to judge
not_run.cap-exempt files within their ceilings: goh exempts no file from the line cap (no GOH_LINE_EXCLUDE), so no exempt file has a ceiling to hold
not_run.line-cap exemptions carry a ceiling: goh exempts no file from the line cap (no GOH_LINE_EXCLUDE), so there is no exemption to carry one
not_run.skills corpus: goh's GOH_SKILLS_ROOT is the owner's skills corpus under HOME, no part of goh's tree; the walk's HOME is its own and empty (GOH.SELFWALKCI), so the step finds no corpus here, as on a hosted runner
not_run.version provenance: the step reads a repo's .gates-version-baseline.json; goh's version comes from Cargo.toml, judged by its release kit

unjudged.no private repository named in a public: the list of names is the owner's private store, which the walk empties by design; goh's own push judges it with the list
unjudged.one roadmap, open entries only: rule 4 (a cited queue item is done) reads the umbrella queue (.loop/queue.json beside the owner's checkouts), no part of goh's tree; the walk's HOME is its own and empty (GOH.SELFWALKCI), as on a hosted runner; goh's own push judges it with the queue

goh fixed-sleep.why: a test sleep standing for a readiness signal; goh never runs goh fixed-sleep over itself (its GOH_CI_STEPS run status-markers only) and has no fixed_sleep_seed.json

goh status-markers.why: status_marker_seed.json: tui/lib.py and the scanner's own tests print escapes by design (BACKLOG 4.9)

one roadmap, open entries only.why: rule 5 (GOH.ROADMAPIDS): code comments and configs cite plan ids from before the 2026-11-08 rephase (a plan name and a dotted number), which docs/BACKLOG.md says resolve at 1a7c444 (`git show 1a7c444:docs/BACKLOG.md`); the entry each named is in git, not the plan, so the rule reads them dead. roadmap_seed.json holds the same sites per file; rule 5's grace ends 2026-12-01

no bare open of an app.why: tests/test_launch_app.py, the control arm a bare open must be: the Python shape, in grace until 2026-11-23, is seeded that day (its entry would read stale before it)

no hand-rolled TUI mark.why: tui_marks_seed.json's sites (GOH.LINTDELTA fixed py_lint_ceiling.py's), every one seeded (GOH.TUIMARKS; GOH.GRACEEND seeded the 6 it once missed: tools/lint.py, changelog_cut.py, build-goh.sh, and swift_toolchain.sh:28, a zsh refusal before any lib can load, from 6c43a02)

no hard-coded home paths.why: goh never opted into GOH_NO_HOME_PATHS, the rule it ships: its tests, docs and CHANGELOG name home-directory paths

no locale variable set by bash itself.why: locale_prefix_seed.json: tests/fixtures/homebrew_tap/Casks/divoom-control.rb, a copy of the tap's cask, its uninstall heredoc read since GOH.LOCALERUBY

no process kill by name.why: kill_by_name_allow.json, each entry reviewed or unreviewed with its reason
